subject: mathematics
question_text: Find the domain of the real function (2x² − 5x + 7)/((x − 1)(x − 2)(x − 3)).

mark_split.label: Condition for the function to be defined

verification.note: Source: Baby Bullet-Q, Junior Inter Maths-1A (Sri Publishers, Machilipatnam), book p.81 — VSAQ chapter 14 Functions, question 98.2, on ★★★ SSP 81 (the book calls it 'the most dominating domain page'). Appearance years are printed board-split. UNLIKE the LAQ and SAQ pages, the book prints NO internal mark split on its VSAQ pages: the 1+1 across the two steps is our division of the 2 marks, not the source's. Publisher's claims until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms them.

recall_prompt: Say how you would find this domain — the condition the formula forces, and the answer.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Write the condition
steps.margin_note: One of the two marks is for the condition alone. Write it before any factorising.
steps.memory_tip: No root here — only the denominator matters. Find where it is ZERO: x = 1, 2, 3.

recall.must_convey: That only the denominator matters — the numerator is a polynomial and never restricts the domain.
accept: only the denominator matters so set x minus one into x minus two into x minus three not zero
the numerator is a polynomial so it is fine everywhere the denominator decides
the function fails where the bottom is zero which is one two and three
denominator zero ayye chotla function undadu
find where the denominator vanishes and remove those points

steps.why: The denominator is already factorised, so the excluded points can be read straight off it.
common_mistakes: Trying to factorise or restrict the numerator, which imposes no condition at all.
Solving the denominator equal to zero and then reporting those roots as the domain.

steps.label: Write the domain
steps.margin_note: The second mark is the interval itself. Write it in interval form, and check every bracket.
steps.memory_tip: Remove those three points from R. The numerator plays no part.

recall.must_convey: That the domain is all real numbers except 1, 2 and 3.
accept: all real numbers except one two and three
R minus the set one two three
every real except those three roots of the denominator
one two three thappa anni real numbers

steps.why: Each factor gives one excluded point, so three factors remove exactly three numbers from the real line.
common_mistakes: Reporting {1, 2, 3} as the domain instead of what is removed from it.
Missing one factor and excluding only two points.

insider_note: No root and no logarithm, so nothing has to be positive — only the denominator must not vanish. The answer is R minus three points; writing an interval answers a different question.
